title: Customer-Requested Remeasure Fee
content:
# Customer-Requested Remeasure Fee

Window Replacement Contracts — field operations fee note.

**The fee.** The remeasure fee is figured for the most recent customer-requested remeasure recorded as completed on the contract. The remeasure fee is the series remeasure fee of the contract's series, as listed in the measure appointment schedule, rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Which remeasure is charged

| Visits on the contract's history | The remeasure the fee is figured for |
|---|---|
| Several completed customer-requested remeasures | The one with the latest date |
| A customer-requested remeasure booked but not completed, and an earlier completed one | The earlier completed one |
| A company remeasure ordered by Ridgeline | Never the charged remeasure |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A contract in a series with a hypothetical remeasure fee of $100 carries completed customer-requested remeasures dated 2032-04-02 and 2032-05-10. The fee is figured for the 2032-05-10 remeasure and comes to $100.00.
